title: Control Mechanisms
subtitle: Test your grasp of Control Mechanisms — Density Suppression, Overlays, NPCs, the Three Strings, Amnesia Vortex, Resets, and the failing parasitic grid.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Control Mechanisms are the full stack of the Parasitic Takeover — Custodian betrayal, density dimming, fake skies, 97% NPC Mind Camps, Three Strings, thousand-year Resets, and the Amnesia Vortex that steals 178,000 years of memory. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Control Mechanisms deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. As the G.A.A. turns off Overlays, uninstall Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge — and take the flat-earth first step — so the EMF flash finds you awake rather than collapsed.

questions.question: What was the overarching purpose of the multi-layered Control Mechanisms?

options.label: A
options.text: To help Custodians return Gateway-10 to pure 12th-density stewardship under the Source.
options.rationale: The Custodians betrayed the Source and built the prison matrix; control mechanisms serve occupation, not restoration.

options.label: B
options.text: To permanently enslave Taran human souls within Gateway-10 (the Known Lands) for endless Loosh and Adrenochrome harvest.
options.rationale: The Control Mechanisms were designed to permanently enslave Taran souls in Gateway-10 so humanity remains asleep and harvested for Loosh and Adrenochrome across Resets.

options.label: C
options.text: To educate NPCs so they could eventually reincarnate as Twin Flames.
options.rationale: NPCs are recycled rather than reincarnated and enforce conformity; Twin Flame reunion is blocked by the afterlife trap.

options.label: D
options.text: To open the Projection Dome so everyone could see gold statues at the North Pole immediately.
options.rationale: Turning off Overlays and revealing North Pole gold is a G.A.A. counter-action, not the parasites' control purpose.

questions.hint: Think Gateway-10 enslavement and continuous energetic harvest.
